J1.criterion: exactness order = 2p-1 (exact there, wrong one degree beyond) and fitted quadrature order >= 2p-1 for p = 1..4

J2.criterion: L_inf curvature error / kappa_max <= 1e-3 and unit-normal deviation <= 1e-3, against the closed-form ellipsoid/sphere and against a finite-difference route

J3.criterion: order-4 curved elements on 2x2 subdivisions per knot span: volume relative error <= 1e-6 against 4/3 pi R^3 and 4/3 pi a b c

J4.criterion: wetted surface S and block coefficient Cb from NURBS quadrature, STL tessellation and voxel grid all within 0.5% of the independent AGM/Carlson elliptic-integral value

J5.criterion: write-read-recompute is bit identical (recomputed integrals agree to <= 1e-14) and the content hash survives NPZ, HDF5 and JSON

J6.criterion: faceted patch: observed order <= 2 for area and volume, and volume relative error > 1e-3 at 8 and 16 facets per direction (i.e. J1/J3 cannot be met by facets)

J7.criterion: pytest tests/test_highorder_geometry.py wall time <= 120 s and all green
